4.0.0: Vitrine: a floating glass rail on any edge replaces the bar; left by default, or right, top or bottom, floating or flush
One deck beside the rail holds every page, with its own side to move between them (Alt and a figure, Ctrl and Tab)
New Media page: the cover on its own colours, the timeline, the keys and every player
New Focus page: tasks, focus rounds or a countdown, and a note, shared with every family
The rail shows the workspace's windows, the tray, the status, the clock and power; each key names itself on hover
Neutral smoked glass with a rim of light; pearl, glacier, sage, coral, gold or the wallpaper's colour as the accent
Settings wears the deck's layout: a side plate and the options in grouped plates
3.1.1: The hot corner opens the overview once per arrival: it no longer jumps back to the workspace
3.1.0: Power is a selector you turn: five keys around a ring, by pointer, wheel or arrows
The lock shows the time inside a ring that tells the minute and counts the password as you type
The clipboard reads the marked entry in full, text or picture, and filters by kind
Wallpapers show the marked picture large before you wear it
Notifications, the tray menu, network and sound lists and the overview cards use the new controls
3.0.0: Instrument: warm black glass and one light replace the violet; what is on is solid in that light
NiHiL drops the Material colours: its own dark and light scheme, its own lights or the wallpaper's most vivid colour
Control is an instrument panel: two dials, wide radios, round keys and the cover of what plays
Settings, Today, the launcher, the bar, the dock and the OSD are rebuilt on the new controls
2.1.0: Horizon: every surface is now one sheet of black glass whose edge is a line of light that travels to what is active
Apps and search open as a page of the bar, with the kinds of app, a larger search field and results in place
Control, Today, Clipboard, Wallpapers, notifications and the OSD are redrawn as parts of the same sheet
Power and the lock screen bend the bar into the horizon of a dark planet, with the password resting on it
Settings is one sheet with lit pages and quiet groups, and Appearance opens with the wallpaper and its lights
Shared surfaces and widgets without their own face now wear NiHiL
2.0.0: NiHiL is rebuilt as quiet premium glass: graphite smoked glass, Geist in sentence case and one accent for what is on
The overview is the compositor's own on Niri and Umbriel, with NiHiL's search, dash and workspace strip over the blurred wallpaper
New Settings: every NiHiL option and the computer's own, from screens, windows, keyboard and mouse to sound, power and wallpaper
Bar, Control, Today, Power, lock, OSD, notifications, the app grid and the desktop widgets redrawn on the same glass
A dock on the desktop with its own size and glass, tray menus with checks, radios and submenus, four layouts to start from
Settings opens over the desktop or as a window with move, maximize and close keys; menus stay readable over anything
1.3.0: NiHiL is rebuilt as a rack: packed black, paper and signal tiles, heavy figures and its own glyphs in every panel
Bar, Start, Control, Today, Power, Menu, Wallpapers and Clipboard share one player, faders and stat tiles
1.2.0: NiHiL's own Today (the month and every notification), wallpapers, clipboard and password asks, with nothing of Material's under them
Control leads to the Wi-Fi networks, the Bluetooth devices and the sound outputs and inputs, in its own piece
The bar shows the screen's workspaces as dots; the time opens Today and a dot marks notifications
New type: Hanken Grotesk for reading, Doto for the dot figures
1.1.0: NiHiL has its own Settings window: every page, live search, and full control of the signal colour, pieces, corners, dots, type and motion
1.0.0: NiHiL: a floating bar, dot-matrix clock and widgets, Start, quick controls, a power card and its own menu, in one signal colour

summary: A floating glass rail on any edge and one deck that holds every page.
